facts.fact: Gabon Media Time reports that the law ratifying the social-network ordinance, promulgated by decree 0436/PR of 5 October 2026, bans deepfakes of public or private persons (art. 32) and requires editors within 12 months to deploy AI-content detection and a visible, permanent label on AI-generated content (art. 53).
facts.system: Law ratifying the ordinance on social-network regulation

note: No body with a mandate over AI harms is named (only a judge in summary proceedings), and no enforcement is stated.
